motions.label: Programmed jump · latest CAD
motions.description: 265 mm wheel clearance · 194 mm COM rise · lands and settles.
motions.limit_text: Nominal programmed simulation: balance and jump pass at 250/125 µs. Updated 2.61 kg mass and explicit rotating gears; hardware, TPU compliance, backlash and thermal limits remain unqualified.

limitations: Unweighed detailed CAD plus explicit mass priors; full-density unsliced PETG/TPU prints.
Four torque actuators and six passive rotating groups. Gear ratios include rotor/carrier inertia coupling.
Ideal gear equalities omit the new spacing allowance's backlash, tooth compliance and efficiency variation.
Ground contact uses outer CAD convex hulls and rigid 120 mm tire cylinders; no TPU compliance or complete self-contact model.
Battery/FOC channels, cooling, current conventions, motor resistance/torque, rotor inertia and guide friction need identification.
No hardware validation follows; this revision must repeat its own motion and timestep/sensitivity checks.
